title: Exercise: Computer Science majors
description: Names of all Computer Science majors, A to Z.

input.query: -- Write your query here, then press Run.

exercise.prompt: List the names of all students majoring in Computer Science, sorted alphabetically.
exercise.solution:
SELECT s.name
FROM students AS s
JOIN departments AS d ON d.dept_id = s.major_dept
WHERE d.name = 'Computer Science'
ORDER BY s.name;
